versions.changelog:
openclaw-screen-viewer 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Adds Python-based screen capture and image processing capabilities (full screen or region).
- Supports screenshot saving, text extraction via OCR (Chinese and English), and basic image editing (crop, rotate, resize).
- Provides scripts for quick capture, OCR, region selection, and screen content analysis.
- Includes detailed usage, installation, and troubleshooting instructions for multiple platforms.
